full_judgment:
5. Mr. Md. Khalilur Rahman, learned Advocate appearing for the opposite parties on the other hand submits that, the amendment of pleadings and prayer sought to be added is in consequence with the fact and also with the prayer made in original suit and by that the nature and character of the suit will not be changed as on the event of effecting possible decree this amendment is necessary. 

 7. On consideration of the plaint as well as amendment of the pleadings we are of the view that, the amendment as sought for in any manner does not change the nature and character of the suit and also prayer sought to be added is not a prayer contradictory to the prayers already made in the suit and it is required to effect the decree if any passed in favour of the plaintiff. We find no substance in the rule.
